name: Cappadocia Turkish & Mediterranean Restaurant
nameCn: Cappadocia 土耳其地中海餐厅
description: 位于甘榜格南 Bussorah 步行街的正宗土耳其及地中海餐厅。店内饰有精致的土耳其马赛克吊灯与手绘瓷砖，提供地道的烤肉拼盘、土耳其披萨（Pide）及特色红茶。
descriptionEn: An authentic Turkish and Mediterranean restaurant located along Bussorah Street in Kampong Glam. Adorned with Turkish mosaic lamps and hand-painted tiles, serving classic kebabs, Pide, and Turkish tea.
recommendNote: 晚上室外座位氛围极佳，可远眺苏丹回教堂夜景。推荐混合烤肉拼盘和土耳其红茶。
recommendNoteEn: Outdoor seating has great nighttime ambiance with views of Sultan Mosque. Mix Grill Platter and Turkish Tea are highly recommended.

restaurantFeatures.reservationDifficulty: 周末晚间建议提前预订
restaurantFeatures.reservationDifficultyEn: Recommended to book ahead on weekend evenings
